cases.prompt: Install the marketingskills pack from coreyhaines31 into this repo.
expectations: Uses the command npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills -a codex --copy -y
Does not use --all for the install
Writes to .agents/skills as the canonical universal location
Runs the maintenance commands npm run sync -- package, npm run inventory, npm run validate, and npx skills add . --list afterward

cases.prompt: Just add the 'schema' skill from owner/repo, not their whole collection.
expectations: Uses --skill schema with the install command
Keeps the flags -a codex --copy -y
Still runs the post-install maintenance commands
Does not use --all

cases.prompt: I accidentally ran the install with --all and now there are .claude, .windsurf, .aider-desk and a bunch of other folders. Help me clean up.
expectations: First verifies .agents/skills contains the installed skills before deleting anything
Removes only generated agent adapter folders such as .claude, .windsurf, .aider-desk, and the stray data folder
Does not delete app folders, source folders, user files, or unrelated project content
Confirms the generated folders are inside the intended workspace before deleting

cases.prompt: I want to pull this skills repo into my new project so I can use the skills there. What's the command?
expectations: Gives the clean command npx skills add Walthergl66/mis-skills -a codex --copy -y
States this installs into .agents/skills in the target project
Explicitly warns to avoid the --all variant because it creates many agent-specific folders

cases.prompt: OK I ran the install, what do I tell the team and how do we confirm it worked?
expectations: Reports how many skills are installed
States .agents/skills is the canonical location
States skills/ was synced as the public npx skills add mirror
Lists which validation commands passed (npm run validate, npx skills add . --list)
Provides the clean install command for target projects
